simple.summary: תִּירְיָא (Tîyrᵉyâʼ) means fearful , Tirja , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 16.

definitions.full: H8493. Tireya ִתּירְיָא proper name, masculine (in Judah) 1Chr 4:16 van d. H, apparently derives from v ירא , compare MV Buhl; but Baer תִּרְיָא ( ᵐ5 B om.; A Θηρια , ᵐ5 L Εθρια ). תִּירְיָא proper name, masculine in Judah , 1Chr 4:16 ; Ζαιρα , A Θηρια , ᵐ5 L Εθρια .
